description: The bar chart illustrates GPU memory usage for several fine-tuning approaches, with each method represented by a single vertical bar. The horizontal axis contains the method categories, shown as rotated labels in the order: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, and Ours; no explicit horizontal axis label is shown. The vertical axis is labeled “GPU Memory (GB)” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 20, 40, and 60 (gridlines aligned to these ticks), with the plotted range extending to roughly the mid-70s GB. Five bars (Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA) are colored orange and one bar (Ours) is colored green; their approximate heights are: Full FT around 72–73 GB, MTL-FT around 39–40 GB, TAG around 21 GB, LoRA around 21 GB, QLoRA around 12–13 GB, and Ours around 21 GB. The bars are not shown as stacked or grouped beyond being separate single-series bars, and there are no visible annotations, outlines, or legend indicating additional encodings; the categories appear in a fixed listed order rather than being explicitly sorted by value.
